low_color_source.palette_source: retained color10 from fixed b41 normal capture; not defined by SPRIT palette; runtime used-RGB equality required
low_color_source.evidence_level: proven source index and independent decode; normal event/color10 unobserved, conditional reference only

materials.moderation_attempt: one four-call batch rejected before saved output; rejected asset unknown; safe fully clothed descriptions used on retry
materials.framing: 084@1 r4 whole-image uniform reduction plus black padding; parameters in review manifest; no crop or recoloring

source_diagnostics.scope: 六類完整PNG前景、來源0與框外、兩背景、直接及舊合成相同、先選HD、使用RGB撤除、未用RGB隔離、透明區改動、失配撤候選及改格回退、冷失配、未證實位置、清除、2倍／F12、輸入不變及衝突回退。未變格沿既有鎖存；其餘54張未逐件執行期驗證。
source_diagnostics.production_change: 60 fixed source/indexed and used-RGB signatures; one original color10 point allowed only after exact key/source SHA; Go rendering algorithms unchanged

runtime.scope: 二十組60張來源素材；六類診斷另計，正常DEMO只驗既有十四張及終點不變，新正常事件未知

normal_draw.scope: 本次正常DEMO與F10合成；既有Go核心未改，不外推其他路線或FPS

receipt.input_scope: Git files and explicitly supplied original DAX only; no old workplace
receipt.rights: private review inputs; original indexes reconstructed locally

portable_rebuild.scope: 乾淨Git引擎重編逐位元相同；乾淨主專案與自備DAX重建1525檔及六份字型，每檔相同。僅Linux amd64容器，其他平台未驗。

activation.method: new binary verified on old theme, then Linux renameat2 RENAME_EXCHANGE of complete theme
